additions.label: Fractal Synthesis
additions.description: Paths, branches, grains, waves, echoes and textures connect playable geometry to articulated synthesis, recursive rhythm and live input. Each has distinct engines, expanded controls and ADSR envelopes.
additions.start: Choose a tab, enable Audio and Play, then drag the geometry. Explore presets, use the information buttons, or explicitly connect a microphone to reshape live sound.
